task.title: Configuring the system to trust the certificate authority
task.shortdesc: To trust your self-signed certificate authority, you can add the root CA to the system-wide trust store and update certificate configuration. You can verify trust with the trust list command before browsing your Red Hat Quay registry over HTTPS.

Enter the following command to update the system-wide trust store configuration:
Optional. You can use the trust list command to ensure that the Quay server has been configured:

info.codeblock: $ trust list | grep quay label: quay-server.example.com
info.p: Now, when you browse to the registry at https://quay-server.example.com, the lock icon shows that the connection is secure:
